response.sql:
SELECT e.status, AVG(b.amount - b.spent) AS avg_amount_minus_spent, COUNT(*) AS budget_line_count
FROM budget AS b
JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE b.spent > 6.0
GROUP BY e.status;

assumptions.assumption: “Number of such budget lines” counts each matching budget row, and the average ignores rows where either amount or spent is NULL, as SQL AVG does.
